subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move it to a Settings/Config information area, or keep config-path discovery out of Control UI?
rationale: The technical change is narrow, but the linked request leaves the location open and the UI would prominently expose an absolute local path that is already available through non-UI troubleshooting surfaces.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only Overview row after live UI proof confirms the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing configPath field to be surfaced in a less prominent settings/config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline UI exposure and rely on existing CLI/config troubleshooting surfaces for active config discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only Overview row after live UI proof confirms the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest historical signal for the Overview presentation surface that would receive this visible row.
